format: EPS native binary (.nat, may be zipped)
origin: EUMETSAT Data Store via eumdac (collection EO:EUM:DAT:METOP:AVHRRL1)
disabled_reason: needs EUMETSAT Data Store credentials (EUMETSAT_CONSUMER_KEY / EUMETSAT_CONSUMER_SECRET environment variables; this class does not fall back to ~/.eumdac/credentials).
unverified: No real fetch was run: the credential environment variables are not set on this machine, so time and ctor_kwargs are untested against the Data Store.
notes: No model in the repo reads MetOpAVHRR; variables are the full MetOpAVHRRLexicon.VOCAB (earth2studio/lexicon/metop.py), a single variable that expands to one row per field of view per channel in a pandas DataFrame.
Defaults kept: all satellites, time_tolerance +/-1 h.
Each AVHRR orbit file is about 1 GB (metop_avhrr.py docstring); with the default +/-1 h window and all satellites expect several GB. Default subsample=1 kept.
